title: Cancelling Turn Off Technician also cancels a confirmed Sales Rep removal
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, with Sales Representative on, who holds nothing except the work named below.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in In Progress, led by staff member A, with no line that staff member A is on, so the warning has a led work order to count.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Switch Sales Representative off.
  3. Confirm the Sales Representative removal warning.
  4. Switch Technician off.
  5. Click Save & Close.
  6. Click Cancel in the warning.
  7. Close the Edit Staff Member window with its X.
  8. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Staff Member window opens with Sales Representative on and Technician on.

Step 2:

  • The Sales Representative removal warning shows.

Step 3:

  • Sales Representative is off.

Step 4:

  • Technician is off.

Step 5:

  • The warning window titled "Turn Off Technician" shows, with a Cancel button and a Save button.

Step 6:

  • The warning closes.
  • The Edit Staff Member window is still open with Sales Representative off and Technician off, as you left them.

Step 7:

  • The window closes.

Step 8:

  • Sales Representative is on and Technician is on: nothing was saved, including the Sales Representative removal.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11880 (Story 2, Warning before turning Technician off)

  • S2-E3: “Turning off Sales Representative still shows its existing removal warning at the moment that toggle is switched off, as today; the Turn Off Technician warning shows only on Save. Cancelling the Turn Off Technician warning cancels the whole save, including a Sales Representative removal already confirmed, and the window stays open as the user left it.”
  • S2-R4: “The window has Cancel and Save. Save continues the staff save as in S1-R6. Cancel, the X or Escape close the warning and leave the staff member unsaved, with the staff window still open and the toggle as the user left it; clicking outside the warning does nothing. While the counts load after Save, the Save button shows its loading state and cannot be clicked again. Closing the staff window while the counts load cancels the save: nothing is saved and no warning shows. Save in the warning saves the staff member exactly as the window showed when the warning opened.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
